description.value:
You call up the giant wild rose, a flower famous for both its beauty and its thorns. The rose occupies the space of a Huge creature but has no Speed.

Arrive Writhing Vines A vast number of thorny vines burst from the ground, wrapping around those who threaten you. Each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] of the rose takes @Damage[(max(3,floor(@item.rank/2)))d12[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage and must attempt a @Check[reflex|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:grabbed,inflicts:restrained] saving throw.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed] by a vine for the duration of the spell or until they [[/act escape]].

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained] by a vine for the duration of the spell or until they Escape.

Depart (poison) Blood Pollen All creatures still grabbed or restrained by vines take @Damage[(max(2,floor(@item.rank/2)-1))d6[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage] damage. The wild rose then expels a cloud of toxic pollen in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] up to 60 feet away. All living creatures in the burst must attempt a @Check[fortitude|options:area-effect,inflicts:enfeebled|traits:poison] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is enfeebled 2 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

Heightened (+2) The rose's arrival damage increases by 1d12, and its departure damage increases by 1d6.

duration.value: until the end of your next turn
